medical_document_text: EXAM: Ultrasound Retroperitoneal, Limited. INDICATION: 62-year-old male with right flank pain, follow-up of known right renal cyst. TECHNIQUE: Real-time grayscale ultrasound imaging of the right kidney was performed with image documentation. FINDINGS: The right kidney is visualized and measures 11.2 x 5.1 x 4.8 cm. Cortical thickness and echogenicity are within normal limits. There is no evidence of right-sided hydronephrosis, shadowing renal calculus, or solid mass. A simple anechoic cyst is re-demonstrated in the lower pole of the right kidney, measuring 2.4 x 2.1 x 2.2 cm. This is unchanged from the prior examination dated 8 months ago. The left kidney, abdominal aorta, and inferior vena cava were not evaluated during this targeted examination. IMPRESSION: 1. Unchanged 2.4 cm simple cyst in the lower pole of the right kidney. 2. No right hydronephrosis or sonographic evidence of obstructive uropathy.
